<RecipeSection label="Problem">

A support issue arrives with a URL or a short description, but the first response still requires someone to reconstruct the evidence, identify the next diagnostic, and write a safe customer update.

<RecipeSection label="Evidence before hypothesis">

The prompt asks the Agent to separate observed Glean evidence from hypotheses and to disclose when evidence is insufficient.

</RecipeSection>

<RecipeSection label="No external write">

The beginner recipe only prints the Agent response; it does not update a ticket, send a message, or close an issue.

</RecipeSection>

<RecipeSection label="The Agent is configured separately">

The recipe invokes a published conversational Agent. It does not teach Agent Builder, tool governance, or form-triggered input schemas.

</RecipeSection>

<TakeItFurther>

- Add a streaming response so a support engineer can see the Agent's progress.
- Pass structured issue fields after you have a form-triggered Agent and its input schema is verified.
- Pair this recipe with a Trigger that creates a triage request when a support-relevant event arrives.

</TakeItFurther>
